description:
Cha Sunwoo, the broadcasting station’s signature announcer of TBC and the only son of “Handman”. For him, love is like Jenga. Even tho it looks perfect at first it gradually collapses…So he doesn’t believe in falling in love at first sight. 

*“I feel in love at first sight, I love you, Mr. Cha Sunwoo.”* …Except for spending the night with Lee Gyuwon two years ago. *"Why didn’t you contact me, I’ve been waiting all this time?”* 

Seonwoo and Gyuwon, reunite as announcers and reporters at the TBC new agency, which acts as a battlefield. Gyuwon, whether at work or at home, purses Seonwoo again and begins a breathtaking and tempting journey. Seonwoo, who tries not to fall into the fierce but tempting courtship… 

*“Ha, I’m going crazy because of you. What do you want to do with me?”.*
